solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Worry unnecessarily about eastern safety devices

indicators.note: about means the first piece is wrapped around the second

parts.note: to fuss is to worry over trifles

explanation.surface: Someone fretting needlessly over the safety equipment in an eastern building.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical circuits are protected by these small wire links that melt when overloaded, so they are safety devices.

clue.text: Fancy keeping Latin tone

indicators.note: keeping means holding the other piece inside

parts.note: to fancy something is to favour it

explanation.surface: Elaborate language holding on to its Latin tone.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name the distinctive character or quality of something, such as the feel of a piece of writing.

clue.text: What may help one improve delivery?

definitions.text: What may help one improve delivery?

parts.words: What may help one improve delivery?
parts.note: delivery suggests a courier or a bowler, but here means the way one speaks

explanation.surface: Seemingly about faster parcels or better bowling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'delivery' suggests post or a cricket bowler; it is the manner of speaking, which a clinician can help a stammerer or stroke patient improve.
explanation.definitionFit: Clinical treatment for disorders of speech and language helps a person's spoken delivery.

clue.text: Track about boy and female, romantically attached?

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the others

parts.note: spoor is the track or trail of an animal
Ken is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A trail circling a young couple, perhaps sweethearts.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone already claimed by a partner is idiomatically described this way, meaning taken.

clue.text: Beginning to tackle extortionate charge for a horizontal beam

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter, here of tackle

parts.note: a ransom is a sum extorted for the release of a captive

explanation.surface: Starting work on a beam that costs an outrageous amount.
explanation.definitionFit: Builders use this term for the crosspiece set above a door or window, a horizontal timber or stone bar.

clue.text: Deal with country at last in pact

parts.note: to treat a subject is to deal with it

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of the word country

explanation.surface: Two nations finally reaching an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal agreement between states is a synonym for a pact.

clue.text: Donkey in Christmas story

indicators.note: in signals letters sitting within the words that follow

explanation.surface: The donkey that features in the Nativity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters across christmAS Story; the Nativity donkey makes the definition look like part of a general-knowledge question.
explanation.definitionFit: The two words are plain synonyms for the long-eared beast of burden.

clue.text: Unfortunate retirees, so sad leaving Blackpool, maybe

indicators.note: unfortunate letters are ill-arranged, so they get reshuffled

explanation.surface: Pensioners sorry to be leaving a holiday town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unfortunate' rearranges RETIREES SO SAD; 'leaving' is only a link. Blackpool is a resort town on England's north-west coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackpool is an example of a coastal holiday town; 'maybe' marks the definition by example.

clue.text: I am contracted in Maine to produce a type of theatrical drama

indicators.note: in places the shortened form inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: ME is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Maine
the contracted form of I am is I'm

explanation.surface: An actor in Maine staging a show.
explanation.definitionFit: This is silent acting by gesture alone, a form of theatrical performance.

clue.text: Woodland plant, unique, given inaccurate name originally

indicators.note: originally says the jumbled name comes at the start, before the other piece
an inaccurate version of the word name has its letters jumbled

parts.note: something unique is the only one

explanation.surface: A one-of-a-kind woodland plant that was first given the wrong name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given' reads as a link but joins the pieces, while 'originally' says the rearranged word comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The wood anemone is a white-flowered spring plant of woodland floors, an example of the category.

clue.text: Small friendly crowd

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a warm welcome is a friendly one

explanation.surface: A modest, sociable gathering of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense moving mass of people or insects is a throng, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Where players play in front of play's players, perhaps

definitions.text: Where players play in front of play's players, perhaps

parts.words: Where players play in front of play's players, perhaps
parts.note: the first players are musicians, the second play's players are actors on a stage; the musicians sit in a sunken area just in front of the stage

explanation.surface: A tongue-twister about where performers perform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'players' shifts from musicians to actors: the musicians play from a sunken well in front of the stage where the cast performs.
explanation.definitionFit: In a theatre the musicians sit in a lowered space before the stage, in front of the actors.

clue.text: Get to know when definite

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
definite and certain are synonyms

explanation.surface: Learning something once it is settled.
explanation.definitionFit: To find out for sure is to establish a fact, the same as coming to know it.

clue.text: Countersign, please, in absence of head

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, which goes missing here

parts.note: to please someone is to gratify them

explanation.surface: A request to sign a document while the boss is away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'please' looks like a polite request; it is the verb meaning to satisfy.
explanation.definitionFit: To countersign a treaty or agreement is to confirm it formally, which is the sense of the answer.

clue.text: Second best comic?

definitions.note: used as a noun: something or someone very funny

parts.note: the cream is the best part, as in the cream of the crop

explanation.surface: Asking whether a comedian is merely the runner-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a hilarious person or situation is called this, so it means something comic.

clue.text: French dramatist's further entertaining story

indicators.note: entertaining means taking in a guest, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: further and more both mean additional
a story can be a fib, a lie

explanation.surface: A French playwright's next amusing tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertaining' looks like an adjective for the story; it is the containment signal, the host taking in its guest. The 's on dramatist's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of Tartuffe and The Misanthrope was a seventeenth-century French playwright.

clue.text: Remember about ring

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to ring is to call on the phone

explanation.surface: Reminding someone about a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring back to mind is the same as remembering, a synonym.

clue.text: King, or fine English author

parts.note: George is the name of six English kings
feeling fine is being well

explanation.surface: A list choosing between a king and some fine English writer.
explanation.definitionFit: The writer of Animal Farm and Nineteen Eighty-Four was born Eric Blair and wrote under this pen name.

clue.text: Endlessly obstruct alliance

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: to obstruct is to block

explanation.surface: An alliance that keeps getting in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of nations or parties combined for a common purpose is an alliance.

clue.text: Pick up king, then knight

parts.note: Lear is the king in Shakespeare's tragedy
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A chess move: lift the king, then the knight.
explanation.walkthrough: N for knight comes from chess notation, since K is already the king.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up a skill or language is to acquire it by study, a synonym.

clue.text: Catch number coming up

indicators.note: in a down entry coming up means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: A catch with a number coming up, like a lottery win.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch a fish is to land it in a mesh, so the verb means to catch.

clue.text: Sailor, unaccompanied, finds shellfish

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a common crossword sailor
someone unaccompanied is on their own

explanation.surface: A lone seaman discovers some shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: This edible sea snail with an ear-shaped, pearly shell is a kind of shellfish.

clue.text: Cut glass items — shed tears by booth having only one left

parts.note: to cry is to shed tears

indicators.note: of the two L's (left) in the word for a booth, only one remains

parts.note: a market stall is a booth

explanation.surface: Someone weeping beside a market booth that has only one cut-glass piece remaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' is L, so 'having only one left' drops one L from STALL; it looks like stock running out.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine decorated lead glass and the objects made from it are called by this name collectively.

clue.text: Gunpowder constituent in silver tinderbox brought back

indicators.note: brought back says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An ingredient for gunpowder carried home in a silver tinderbox.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the letters hidden across silvER TINderbox, which 'brought back' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate, saltpetre, is the oxidising ingredient in black powder, mixed with charcoal and sulphur.
